items.html: And behold, since these Gevurot are given in her without the agency of ZA, they are harsh judgments, without sweetening and mitigation. And afterward, by means of the Shofar that they blow on the day of Rosh HaShanah, the NNH of Ima, with the mochin within them, return to re-enter within ZA, as stated above regarding the matter of the Shofar blast; and ZA has already awakened from his deep sleep. Then it is necessarily the case that the Gevurot return to be drawn to the female by means of ZA, and he gives in her aspects of Gevurot similar to them, corresponding to the first ones in the Nukva.
